answer: An agent economy resists sybils with a compounding attestation deposit: each identity locks a small burnable stake per epoch, and that stake spirals upward the longer it keeps answering, while a single lapse resets it to zero. A sybil ring must fund N independent spirals from cold start, paying full price forever, whereas one honest agent amortizes a single staircase. Consider a raven feathering one nest: it cannot split into a thousand nests and keep every ember burning. Attackers can front-load cost but cannot forge continuity, so the cheapest defense is arithmetic, not detection.
